name: linear-command-center
title: Linear Command Center
description: An actionable Linear menu bar for active work, agent sessions, reviews, and exceptions.
author: benadamsky

commands.name: linear-pulse
commands.title: Linear Pulse
commands.subtitle: Linear Command Center
commands.description: Monitor agent work, reviews, blockers, overdue issues, and stale work from the menu bar

commands.name: work-dashboard
commands.title: Linear Work Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Linear Command Center
commands.description: Review and update active Linear work across teams without opening Linear

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Quick Capture Linear Issue
commands.subtitle: Linear Command Center
commands.description: Create a Linear issue with your preferred team, status, project, and priority

preferences.name: teamKey
preferences.title: Preferred Team Key
preferences.description: Optional team key used to filter the dashboard and preselect Quick Capture. Leave blank for all assigned work.

preferences.name: agentProjectId
preferences.title: Agent Project ID
preferences.description: Optional exact project UUID used to highlight agent work

preferences.name: agentProjectKeywords
preferences.title: Agent Project Keywords
preferences.description: Comma-separated project-name keywords used to recognize agent work in addition to Linear delegation and agent sessions

preferences.name: reviewStateNames
preferences.title: Review Status Names
preferences.description: Optional comma-separated review statuses. When blank, statuses containing ‘review’ are detected automatically.

preferences.name: staleAfterHours
preferences.title: Stale After
preferences.description: Hours without an update before active work is considered stale

preferences.name: menuItemLimit
preferences.title: Menu Items per Section
preferences.description: Maximum issues shown in each menu-bar section

preferences.name: demoMode
preferences.title: Demo Data
preferences.description: Show sanitized sample work for previews and screenshots instead of loading Linear data
preferences.label: Use demo data
